constraints: Use the CONDITIONAL statistic, not the aggregate histogram: the aggregate is the statistic that falsified this axis once already and the conditional one reverses it. Carries the same hex-immediate normaliser as the other two census tools and requires it for the copy detector to be two-sided.
name: addrlo_shadow_probe
purpose: Cross-tabulates prologue-shadow fill size against the ADDR16_LO home-copy surplus, per function, on both sides. It is the tool that showed the shadow axis is NOT dead: the aggregate shadow histogram is near-identical between builds, but 21 of the image's 28 ours-larger shadow disagreements are exactly the shadow-coupled P functions.
usage: Run from the repo root after a green ninja. Prints the shadow-size disagreement count, the 2x2 of (ours-hoists-MORE x shape-B surplus), the shadow-subgroup roster with both sides' literal shadow contents, the non-shadow subgroup, and a control list of functions that hoist more without paying a copy.
